questions.question: What feast does the LORD prepare in Isaiah 25?
options: A great sacrifice of many bulls and goats on the altar
A banquet for the kings of the nations only
A fast of mourning for the fallen city
A feast of rich food and aged wine for all peoples
questions.answer: A feast of rich food and aged wine for all peoples

questions.question: What will the LORD swallow up forever in Isaiah 25?
options: Death, and he will wipe away tears from all faces
The mountains, and the valleys will be raised
The seas, and dry land will appear again
The wicked, and the righteous will rejoice
questions.answer: Death, and he will wipe away tears from all faces

questions.question: Isaiah 25 says the LORD has been a stronghold to the poor and needy in their distress.
He will swallow up _____ forever; and the Lord GOD will wipe away tears from all faces.
For You have worked _____ — plans formed long ago — in perfect faithfulness.
